paths.name: Data
paths.description: The database (library, users, progress), cover art in gamevault/media, save files, config.yaml, logs and secret keys.

paths.name: Files
paths.description: Your game library: DRM-free games as .zip, .7z or .rar files or folders. You can point this at a games folder you already have.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: GameVault web UI, API and game downloads, published on host as 6149

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: The user id that owns the app's files. 500 is the MOS default.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: The group id that owns the app's files. 500 is the MOS default.

variables.name: PUBLIC_URL
variables.description: The address you open GameVault at, like http://192.168.1.20:6149. Change localhost to your server IP. It is only used for sign-in with OAuth2 (like authentik or Pocket ID).
